verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video-generation tool, so a presenter-led avatar video is a fair question for it. The evidence describes something different: you start from a reference video, and it produces 2D stylized animation with original or user-supplied character designs and TTS narration. Nothing documents pasting a script to get a talking presenter with a stock or custom avatar. Characters and narration are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
